sweep_objective: validation accuracy on a 1500-row slice of TRAIN, tie-break ECE (inherited from R-TM-01, unchanged)

hidden_rule_terms: R2: (any gate fails) XOR (reviewer_verdict == reject) - the automated checks and the reviewer disagree in either direction
R3: cross_domain_quantity_changed AND interface_node_touched AND reviewer_verdict == uncertain
R4: reviewer_verdict == reject AND reviewer_confidence == high AND prior_failures_module >= 2
R5: NOT gate_propagation_pass AND domain in {elec, ctrl} AND spec_coverage == low
generator.calibrated_on: pilot seeds 900-902 with LR and GBT only; TM never run on pilot data

a5_recovery_rule.note: R2 requires clauses for both parity directions; R1 excluded (zero train support)

environment.note: tmu 0.8.3 patched for numpy>=2 (np.uint32(~0)); tmu hangs on internal seed 0
